question.en: Discuss the role of the International Finance Corporation (IFC) in fostering private sector growth in emerging economies.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Finance Corporation (IFC) in fostering private sector growth in emerging economies.

modelAnswer.en: The IFC plays a critical role by providing long-term capital, mobilizing private investment, and offering advisory services. It helps bridge the financing gap for private enterprises, promotes sustainable business practices, and improves the investment climate in developing nations.
